grades.lower_bound_mechanism: Cofactor Bound: if cofactor k>a_1, a smooth substitute m=D*c with P(m)=tau* lies in [a_1,a_{j-1}] and is valid, so by Lemma A it is an earlier term, making tau* minimal earlier (Lemma C monotonicity) — contradiction; hence every essential prime <= a_1
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: V = union of divisibility classes over essential primes, periodic mod L = product of essential primes; sequence is the increasing enumeration of V starting at a_1, so a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n>=1
grades.notes: Reduction to blocker/transversal valid set is rigorous; Lemmas A (all valid m in [a_1,a_n] are terms), B (smooth gaps), C (B-monotone survival) are each proved for all cases and combine into a genuine proof of large-prime erasure. Periodicity is global from n=1. Computational checks are supplementary, not load-bearing.
